data: Does the blue line represent 'Test Imagined' goals at the 60k episode mark?

Yes, the blue line represents 'Test Imagined' goals at the 60k episode mark. The caption explicitly states that we split the data into two categories: goals that were imagined (blue) and goals that were not (orange). Additionally, the legend confirms that the blue line corresponds to 'Test Imagined'. The position of the blue line at approximately 0.6 on the y-axis at the 60k episode mark aligns with this interpretation.
